notes:
• Refreshed the dashboard, menus, and setup guide for easier navigation.
• Added smoother session menu animations and corrected Back navigation.
• Improved full-view responsiveness and preview refresh handling.
• Improved the built-in keyboard, text input, and clipboard paste support.
• Added scheduled force rejoin options to Auto Recovery.
• Added Roblox recovery selection for apps with modified package names, with clearer app and instance labels.
• Improved license verification and messages when activation or cloning fails.
• Improved Noka compatibility and fixed a startup crash.
• Added support reports to help troubleshoot activation, cloning, and session issues.
• Cleaned up the activation page. “Copy error details” now appears only after verification fails.
